title: Desarmadero La Torre
description: A parts catalog customers could search before calling, and then a clickable prototype of how the whole yard could run.
role: Product direction, specification, and prototype delivery
constraints: Inventory changed constantly, so staff needed a simple way to keep listings current.
Customers needed to find relevant stock without calling the shop first.
The prototype needed to prove understanding before scope and pricing decisions.
problem: Customers had to call or visit to check a large, changing parts inventory. The yard's own work ran on paper, in WhatsApp, in Excel, and in people's heads.
solution: Built a searchable catalog with a short listing form for staff, then turned one discovery call into a written spec and a clickable prototype for the yard's operations.
result: The owner came back for a second project after the catalog.
He clicked through the prototype but didn't go ahead with the full build.
deliveryHighlights: A catalog with search by make, model, and year, photos, and a way to inquire about a specific part.
A clickable prototype for counter sales, cash-desk payments, dismantle orders, and finding vehicles across 301 parking spots.
